title: VTC Networks — Deliver — payload
description: A network's delivery of a broadcast envelope to the community's group registered for one of the network's roles. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

role.description: The network's role whose registered community group the delivery addresses.

Response.title: VTC Networks — Deliver — response payload
Response.description: Whether the community passed the message on. Deliberately carries no count of the group's members, so the network does not learn the group's size.

status.description: `delivered`: accepted and passed on to the group's members. `duplicate`: the community had delivered this message before; nothing was sent.
